#include <iostream>
#include <gmpxx.h>

int main() {
    mpz_class MOD("998244353");
    long n, m, L, R;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    long length = R - L + 1;

    if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
        mpz_class power = n * m;
        mpz_class baseNumber = length;
        mpz_class result;
        mpz_powm(result.get_mpz_t(), baseNumber.get_mpz_t(), power.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    } else {
        long evenCount = R / 2 - (L - 1) / 2;
        long oddCount = length - evenCount;
        mpz_class E(evenCount);
        mpz_class O(oddCount);
        mpz_class exp(n * m);
        mpz_class sumPart, diffPart, result;

        // sumPart = (E + O)^exp mod MOD
        mpz_class baseSum = E + O;
        mpz_powm(sumPart.get_mpz_t(), baseSum.get_mpz_t(), exp.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());

        // diffPart = (E - O)^exp mod MOD
        mpz_class baseDiff = E - O;
        mpz_powm(diffPart.get_mpz_t(), baseDiff.get_mpz_t(), exp.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());

        // result = ((sumPart + diffPart) * (1 + MOD) / 2) mod MOD
        mpz_class numerator = sumPart + diffPart;
        mpz_class denominator = 2;
        mpz_class inv_two;
        mpz_invert(inv_two.get_mpz_t(), denominator.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t()); // modular inverse of 2
        result = (numerator * inv_two) % MOD;

        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
